layout_dets.text: ABSTRACT

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Universal model excels at handling multi-task and multi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modal medical image segmentation, effectively addressing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the variations between different tasks. However, most ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: isting universal models fail to adequately consider the in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: terrelations between different structures, overlooking their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: latent semantic connections. In this paper, we propose a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: novel prompt-driven model based on in-context learning that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: aims to achieve 3D universal vessel-like curvilinear structure

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation (UniCurvSeg) across domains and modalities.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In UniCurvSeg, a learnable task prompt is designed to cap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture the correlations across all tasks, integrating a modality

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prompt to help the model recognise features from different

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modalities and a region prompt to accurately localize target

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: regions. These prompts are injected into feature maps through

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cross-attention, addressing the challenges of data heterogene-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity and annotation discrepancies. In addition, we incorporate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a dual attention mechanism to learn rich hierarchical repre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sentations of vessel-like structures. Extensive experimental

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: results demonstrate that UniCurvSeg outperforms existing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods on 9 datasets (1662 images) across three modalities

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (CT, MRI, MRA).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Index Terms— Universal model, in-context learning,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: medical image segmentation, multi-attention

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. INTRODUCTION

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Many studies suggest that the geometric and morphological

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: changes of vessel-like structures (e.g., hepatic vessel, aorta

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and brain vessel) in medical image are closely linked to var-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ious diseases [1]. Medical image segmentation plays a cru-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cial role in computer-aided detection and diagnosis, enabling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: precise delineation of anatomical structures. In recent years,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: deep learning (DL) has achieved remarkable success in med-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ical image segmentation, with single-task models[2] [3] be-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coming the prevailing paradigm. However, due to the high

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cost of medical data collection and annotation, single-task

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model is often constrained by limited training data. Further-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: more, different tasks require specialized networks, resulting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in distributed research efforts.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Several strategies, including multi-head and universal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models, have been proposed to address these challenges.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Multi-head models typically fall into three categories: (1) A

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: shared encoder with task-specific decoders, exemplified by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Med3D [4], which facilitates feature sharing across tasks. (2)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Task-specific encoders with a shared decoder [5], effectively

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: handling diverse input modalities by learning and fusing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: distinct features at a semantic level. (3) Task-specific en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coders and decoders connected through shared middle layers

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [6], balancing specialized learning with knowledge transfer.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, these models require strong task relevance and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: often lead to structural redundancy due to the need for mul-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tiple specialized components. There is a growing interest in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: developing universal models. DoDnet [7] employs one-hot

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoding and a controller to generate dynamic convolutions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for multi-task segmentation. Uniseg [8] introduces a prompt-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: driven universal segmentation model. FedLPPA [9] employs

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: two learnable prompts and n one-hot prompts, integrating

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learnable parameters with predefined one-hot encodings to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: elicit a more nuanced and efficient response. Hermes [10]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: leverages contextual prior learning to effectively integrate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: task and modality information. However, these methods pri-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: marily focus on segmenting various anatomical structures,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: such as organs and tumors, failing to fully harness the seman-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tic consistency shared among similar structures, which limits

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: their performance across diverse structures. In contrast to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: specialized model, universal model can achieve superior per-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: formance by learning from the representations of analogous

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: topologies [11]. In such context, it is desirable to design a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: universal framework for structures with similar morphology.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this paper, we introduce a novel framework with learn-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: able prompts and dual-attention mechanism for universal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessel-like structures curvilinear segmentation (UniCurvSeg).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In UniCurvSeg, prompts represent the task, modality and tar-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: get region, which are fused with feature via a cross-attention

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mechanism, and a dual-attention module is introduced for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: network to efficiently extract vessel-like structures. The con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tributions of our work are as follows:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We propose a universal segmentation paradigm for the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation of vessel-like curvilinear structure, capable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of handling tasks across different anatomical regions and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modalities.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We introduce a Tri-prompt Fusion (TPF) module for in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: context learning, enabling model to adapt to task, modal-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity, and region priors for contextual prompt learning.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • A Dual-attention (DA) module is introduced to generate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attention-aware feature representations, effectively utiliz-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing multi-channel spatial information for feature represen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation and normalization, allowing the network to better

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: distinguish vessel-like structures from the background.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • Results across 9 datasets demonstrate that UniCurvSeg

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: clearly outperforms other single-task and multi-task mod-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: els in the segmentation of vessel-like structures.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2. METHOD

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this section, we first briefly overview our UniCurvSeg

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: framework, followed by an introduction of the TPF and DA

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modules. The TPF module leverages in-context learning,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: allowing the model to grasp shared knowledge across tasks,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modalities, and regions, while the DA module capture rich

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hierarchical representations of vessel-like structures. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: overview of UniCurvSeg is provided in Fig. 1.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.1. UniCurvSeg Paradigm Overview

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Generally, N segmentation tasks requires designing N unique

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: architectures, which limits the ability to leverage information

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from other tasks and prevents the model from capturing se-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mantic connections between similar structures. To address

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: this, we propose a universal vessel-like curvilinear structure

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation framework that enables a single model to per-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: form segmentation across nine common curvilinear structure

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets spanning three modalities. Given a set of N datasets

layout_dets.text: 3. EXPERIMENTS

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1. Dataset and Preprecessing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We collect 9 datasets involving 3 regions—thoracic, abdom-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: inal, and brain—and 3 imaging modalities: CT, MRI, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: MRA. As shown in Table 1, all images come from public

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our model by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: comparing both single-task and universal models. A stan-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dardized preprocessing pipeline is implemented across all

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets within the widely used nnU-Net framework. Firstly,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: all images are aligned to the same coordinate system, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the spacing is resampled to a uniform

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Then, image intensities are normalized, followed by further

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: normalization for each image.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.2. Implementation Details

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We implement UniCurvSeg using PyTorch on NVIDIA RTX

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: A6000 GPU, integrating it within the widely adopted nnU-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Net framework. During training, we utilize the SGD opti-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mizer with a learning rate of 0.01, a batch size of 2, and a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: default patch size of 64

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The model undergoes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: training for 1000 epochs, amounting to 450,000 iterations.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.3. Comparisons with State-of-the-art

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We benchmark UniCurvSeg against several representative

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation frameworks, covering both commonly used

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: single-task model like nnU-Net [2], 3D-TransUNet [21] and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: U-Mamba [22], and universal model, such as DoDnet [7],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Uniseg [8] and Hermes [10]. For a fair comparison, all

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tasks across the single-task models adopt the same number

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of epochs, batch size, and patch size as used in our method.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: It is worth noting that 3D-TransUNet employs transformer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoder and transformer encoder, and U-Mamba only use the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: U-Mmaba block in the bottleneck.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: As shown in Table 2, our method achieves the best perfor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mance on average Dice score and achieves the highest Dice

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: score on 8 clinical anatomical structures in 6 datasets. More-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: over, UniCurvSeg also present superior performance with an

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: average margin of 1.49% compared to second-best universal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model, demonstrating its superior performance. Visualization

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: results for all methods on 4 datasets are provided in Fig. 2.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.4. Ablation Studies

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We conducted a series of intra-component ablations to investi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gate the efffectiveness of each key component in UniCurvSeg.

layout_dets.text: 3.4.1. Ablation studies of TPF

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In the ablation of TPF module, we retain the dual-attention

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: module while systematically ablating the different prompts to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: examine the impact of various prompts. Since TP provides

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the model with explicit task information and guidance, serv-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing as the foundation of the universal model, it remains a con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stant element in this ablation experiment. From Table 3, it is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: evident that the addition of either MP or RP leads to a no-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ticeable improvement in performance, and the integration of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: both, forming the triple prompt composition, achieves the best

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance outcomes.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.4.2. Ablation studies of DA

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Moreover, we explore the effectiveness of the dual attention

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: module. Table 4 demonstrates that variants without attention

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: block yield inferior outcomes. The introduction of either the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spatial attention block or the channel attention block enhances

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance, while the incorporation of both together yields

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the best outcomes, underscoring the importance of the atten-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion module.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4. CONCLUSION

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This study propose a novel universal segmentation frame-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work, UniCurvSeg, to address the challenging problem of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multi-task segmentation. A TPF module and a DA module are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: introduced to enable in-context learning and effectively ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tract vessel-like structures. Extensive experiments conducted

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on nine medical imaging datasets across three modalities

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: successfully demonstrate the superiority of UniCurvSeg.
